description: Weekly-review findings and skill cells. The gates are the sensitive part: a thin record must produce NO ranking on either surface, and a sufficient one must produce the same ranking, or the app and the pipeline would publish different claims from identical data.

cases.name: 8 checks — a large apparent gap must still yield no ranking

expected.data_sufficiency: Reviewed 8 day(s) of stored forecasts (2026-08-13 to 2026-08-20), of which 8 have observations to score against. Day+0: 8 check(s) per model — directional only, not yet enough to rank models against each other.

cases.name: 30 checks — a real gap is ranked

expected.data_sufficiency: Reviewed 30 day(s) of stored forecasts (2026-07-22 to 2026-08-20), of which 30 have observations to score against. Day+0: 30 check(s) per model — a settled picture.

findings.claim: At Day+0, alpha is the strongest rain caller here and beta the weakest.
findings.evidence: alpha 27/30 (90%) vs beta 9/30 (30%); a 60-point gap, above the 15-point noise floor.

cases.name: 30 checks — a narrow gap is explicitly declined

expected.data_sufficiency: Reviewed 30 day(s) of stored forecasts (2026-07-22 to 2026-08-20), of which 30 have observations to score against. Day+0: 30 check(s) per model — a settled picture.

findings.claim: At Day+0, no model is meaningfully better than the others here yet.
findings.evidence: Best-to-worst spread is only 7 points across 2 models with enough checks to compare, within the 15-point noise floor.
